name: Toilet no Kami-sama, Boshuu Chuu
source:
One day in a pub, I overheard some men talking about "toilet prostitution". While thinking how ridiculous that sounds, I still went to the said toilet to see it for myself. As rumored, there was a girl inside.

Various girls are waiting for customers in a public pool toilet, park toilet, and department store toilet.

I'll continue to pursue those girls as much as my body and wallet can endure.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=748305]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一天在酒吧里，我偶然听到几个男人在谈论“厕所卖淫”。虽然觉得听起来很荒谬，但我还是亲自去了那个厕所看看。如传言所说，里面确实有一个女孩。各种各样的女孩在公共泳池厕所、公园厕所和百货商店厕所里等待着客人。只要身体和钱包还能承受，我会继续追那些女孩。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=748305]Getchu[/url]]
